skills.name: checkin
skills.description: Run the weekly okrdev check-in — pre-drafts the confidence table, "what moved" from git and merged PRs, the drift check, and health metrics before the humans arrive, then walks them through the parts only they can do. Use when someone says "run our check-in", "weekly check-in", "let's do the OKR check-in", "time for the checkin", when a check-in is overdue and the user agrees to catch up, or when a single DRI wants to file their async contribution to this week's check-in.
skills.description_zh: 开展 okrdev 每周检查，先依据 Git 和已合并 PR 起草信心表、进展、偏移检查和健康指标，再引导人员完成必须由人判断的部分，支持负责人异步贡献。

skills.name: coach
skills.description: On-demand status and alignment check from the okrdev coach — confidence trends, drift since the last check-in, health metrics, open-PR status in plain language, and side-quest/maintenance/emergency budget usage. Use when someone asks "how are we doing", "where do we stand on the OKRs", "is this aligned?", "should I build this?", "what should I work on today?", "what's drifting", "any red flags this week", or wants a mid-week pulse without running a full check-in.
skills.description_zh: 按需检查 okrdev 进展和目标对齐，说明信心趋势、上次检查后的偏移、健康、开放 PR 及支线、维护、紧急任务预算，用于周中状态与今日优先事项判断。

skills.name: install
skills.description: Install, upgrade, or level-up okrdev in the current repo. Walks the adoption ladder — Level 0 parking lot, Level 1 method, Level 2 collaboration rails, optional stack module — creating okrdev/ files from templates, appending the marked coach block to the host agent's instructions file (CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md), and merging (never overwriting) anything that already exists. Use when someone says "install okrdev", "set up okrdev", "add okrdev to this repo", "upgrade okrdev", "move us to Level 1/2", or asks how to get started with okrdev.
skills.description_zh: 在仓库安装、升级或提高 okrdev 采用等级，按 Level 0、1、2 及可选技术栈生成模板文件，把 coach 区块追加到 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md，并合并保留已有内容。

skills.name: park
skills.description: Capture an idea into the okrdev parking lot in ten seconds — one line, energy, effort, done — then get back to work. Use when the user says "park this", "park that idea", "add it to the parking lot", "idea for later", "don't let me forget", or when a mid-session idea is about to turn into mid-session work.
headings: If the human wants to work on it now
skills.description_zh: 快速把想法记录到 okrdev 待办想法区，写下一行内容、精力和工作量，避免会话中途直接转成新工作。

skills.name: plan
skills.description: Draft, pressure-test, and activate a cycle of OKRs — 1–3 objectives with measurable key results, one DRI each, and health metrics — written to okrdev/okrs/<cycle>.md. Use when someone wants to plan the next cycle or quarter, set or draft OKRs, start okrdev Level 1, restart after a finished or abandoned cycle, or asks "what should our objectives be?
headings: 4. Gather inputs — before engaging the humans
skills.description_zh: 起草、压力检验并启用一个 OKR 周期，设置 1 至 3 个目标、可衡量关键结果、各自负责人和健康指标，保存到 okrdev/okrs/<cycle>.md。

skills.name: retro
skills.description: Score a finished OKR cycle against the rubric, challenge inflated and sandbagged scores, extract three lessons into okrdev/LESSONS.md, and close the cycle as scored (or abandoned). Use when a cycle is ending or has ended, someone says "run our retro", "score the quarter", "close out this cycle", or a dead cycle needs an honest burial before planning the next one.
headings: 2. The abandoned path — offer it when it's honest
3. Pre-draft the scoring sheet — before engaging the humans
skills.description_zh: 按标准评分结束的 OKR 周期，检查虚高或保守评分，提炼三项经验到 LESSONS.md，并以已评分或已放弃状态关闭周期。

skills.name: side-quest
skills.description: Sanction a distraction on the spot — time-box it, log it in the parking lot, and note what the human is stepping away from. Use when someone wants to chase an off-OKR idea right now ("I know it's not a KR but I want to build this today"), says "side quest", asks to spend an afternoon on something off-plan, wants to extend or close a running side quest, or asks how much side-quest budget is left this week.
headings: Check it's actually a side quest
skills.description_zh: 为立即开展的非 OKR 工作设定时间盒，记录到想法区并注明暂时放下的原任务，管理支线延长、结束及本周剩余预算。

skills.name: triage
skills.description: Walk every parked idea — open okrdev:parked GitHub issues plus the parking lot's Captured section — to a decision (promote, archive, or side-quest with a time-box); then check the side-quest budget. Use when the user says "triage the parking lot", "triage the parked issues", "go through my parked ideas", "clean up the ideas list", or as the parking-lot step of a weekly check-in.
skills.description_zh: 逐条审阅 okrdev:parked GitHub issues 和待办想法区，将想法提升、归档或限时作为支线处理，并检查支线预算。
